questions.question: What does 'runway' refer to?
options: The paved strip where planes take off and land
The area where you collect your luggage
The process of checking passports upon arrival
The seat next to the walkway on a plane
questions.correct_answer: The paved strip where planes take off and land
questions.explanation: Runway nghĩa là đường băng, nơi máy bay cất cánh và hạ cánh.

questions.question: What is 'immigration' at the airport?
options: The area where passports and visas are checked when entering a country
The place where you declare goods
The counter for getting your boarding pass
The storage space above the seats
questions.correct_answer: The area where passports and visas are checked when entering a country
questions.explanation: Immigration là kiểm soát nhập cảnh.

questions.question: What do you do at 'customs'?
options: Declare items you are bringing into the country
Pick up your checked luggage
Board the plane
Store your bag overhead
questions.correct_answer: Declare items you are bringing into the country
questions.explanation: Customs là hải quan, nơi khai báo hàng hóa.

questions.question: Where is the 'baggage claim'?
options: The area where passengers collect their luggage
The place for passport control
The gate for departing flights
The staff serving drinks on the plane
questions.correct_answer: The area where passengers collect their luggage
questions.explanation: Baggage claim là nơi nhận hành lý.

questions.question: What is an 'overhead compartment'?
options: The storage area above the seats for carry-on bags
The line for checking passports
The area to pick up luggage
A seat by the window
questions.correct_answer: The storage area above the seats for carry-on bags
questions.explanation: Overhead compartment là ngăn hành lý trên đầu.

questions.question: Who is a 'flight attendant'?
options: A person who helps and serves passengers on the plane
An officer who checks passports
The pilot of the plane
A person at the baggage claim
questions.correct_answer: A person who helps and serves passengers on the plane
questions.explanation: Flight attendant là tiếp viên hàng không.

questions.question: What is 'turbulence' during a flight?
options: Sudden movements of the plane due to air currents
The delay between two flights
Tiredness after a long flight
The process of boarding the plane
questions.correct_answer: Sudden movements of the plane due to air currents
questions.explanation: Turbulence là sự xáo động không khí, gây rung lắc máy bay.

questions.question: What is 'jet lag'?
options: The feeling of tiredness after flying across time zones
A long line at passport control
The area for collecting bags
A stop between connecting flights
questions.correct_answer: The feeling of tiredness after flying across time zones
questions.explanation: Jet lag là hội chứng mệt mỏi do thay đổi múi giờ.

questions.question: What is a 'layover'?
options: A stop at an airport between connecting flights
The time when the plane leaves the gate
The document to board the plane
The seat next to the aisle
questions.correct_answer: A stop at an airport between connecting flights
questions.explanation: Layover là chuyến trung chuyển hoặc dừng giữa các chuyến bay.

questions.question: What does 'arrival' refer to at the airport?
options: The gate or time when a plane lands
The gate or time when a plane takes off
The process of checking in
The area for luggage pickup
questions.correct_answer: The gate or time when a plane lands
questions.explanation: Arrival là đến nơi, cổng đến của chuyến bay.

questions.question: What does 'departure' mean?
options: The gate or time when a plane leaves
The gate or time when a plane arrives
The control for entering the country
The staff serving on the plane
questions.correct_answer: The gate or time when a plane leaves
questions.explanation: Departure là khởi hành, cổng khởi hành của chuyến bay.

questions.question: What do you do at 'check-in'?
options: Register for your flight and get your boarding pass
Collect your luggage after the flight
Go through passport control
Store your bag in the overhead compartment
questions.correct_answer: Register for your flight and get your boarding pass
questions.explanation: Check-in là làm thủ tục trước khi bay.

questions.question: What is a 'boarding pass'?
options: The ticket or document needed to board the airplane
The area where you wait for your luggage
A seat by the window
The process of declaring items at customs
questions.correct_answer: The ticket or document needed to board the airplane
questions.explanation: Boarding pass là thẻ lên máy bay.

questions.question: What is a 'window seat'?
options: A seat next to the window on the plane
A seat next to the aisle on the plane
The storage above the seats
The area for passport check
questions.correct_answer: A seat next to the window on the plane
questions.explanation: Window seat là ghế cạnh cửa sổ.

questions.question: What is an 'aisle seat'?
options: A seat next to the aisle on the plane
A seat next to the window on the plane
The place to collect luggage
The time between connecting flights
questions.correct_answer: A seat next to the aisle on the plane
questions.explanation: Aisle seat là ghế cạnh lối đi.
